notes.title: Act 3 Update - v0.753 Now Live
notes.notes:
Act 3 is now live on Early Access for everyone to enjoy. Many thanks for those that took part in private beta testing it the last few weeks.

One of the changes that I'd like to highlight is the removal of the visible Objectives List. Due to the nature of the game, it felt like it wasn't required and there was enough information in the game from reading items or discovering them to know what you need to do next. In addition, telling players what to do in a linear way ruined the whole exploration side of things I want to aim for. On that note, here is a very brief list of changes.

[b]v0.753 Patch Notes[/b]
[list]
[*] 2 brand new dungeons for Act 3
[*] Several new enemies for the new dungeons
[*] Difficulty balancing across the game
[*] Removed the Objectives list from the Journal
[*] Additional puzzles in the House
[*] Extra lore to find and read in the House
[*] Mouse sensitivity settings in options
[*] Many bug fixes and improvements
[/list]

NOTE: It is highly recommended that you start a New Game due to the many changes

notes.title: Early Access is coming soon
notes.notes:
As many of you are aware, I have been working alone on this title for 2/3 years now and that can only go so far. In the past I had a wonderful experience developing [b]Dungeon Nightmares 1[/b] (originally on iPhone) with beta testing to help develop and push the game to be the best it could be. [b]Dungeon Nightmares II[/b] also had a Steam Greenlight demo which also helped me in some key decisions for the game. So with that in mind, I am now in a position to put [b]Ergastulum[/b] onto Early Access to let you experience this new nightmare that I have conjured up with.

Finally, this may be the worst kept secret but here is the final logo for [b]Ergastulum[/b] which includes a tiny reveal.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31134522/87b8053dd150f12fbac26c70369cf0b52fcc39fc.png[/img]

notes.title: Experimental Weapons
notes.notes:
Sometimes I create a lot of things behind the scenes that go un-shown but this was a fun little test I did the past week.

I've always had a vision of using Silver Bullets against the Werewolves in the game but had to make sure it was approached carefully without ruining the atmosphere.

The conclusion I have decided with is:

[list]
[*] Very limited ammo in the whole game (you might be lucky to even find 1 bullet in the whole level)
[*] Realistic and slow reloading
[*] Aim is affected by your faith and sanity
[*] Gun jamming is possible
[*] No indication about how much ammunition you have left in the revolver
[*] Very few creatures can be hurt (most will be resistant) 
[*] Possibility that could be a New Game+ reward
[/list]

[previewyoutube=wnM4GR0EyZ8;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Welcome Isserley to the Project!
notes.notes:
[h1]Welcome Isserley[/h1]
I want to start off by welcoming [b]Isserley[/b] to the project. Isserley is going to be composing the original score, which will comprise of Industrial noisiness, ambience and even a little classical! Here is a short blurb from her own mouth.

[quote=Isserley]I've played the beta a whole bunch and you're in for a real treat, as long as you consider being on edge for hours on end a treat[/quote]

And from what she has produced so far, this game is not only going to be a real hellish treat for your eyes but also for your ears. Stay tuned for more updates soon and make sure to check out her [url=https://www.facebook.com/IsserleyIsHome/posts/593710910963181]Facebook[/url] page.

[h1]Even More Enemies?!?[/h1]
